improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Meet Gideon, Your Business & Trade Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-preview.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by stating the core value proposition and free trial offer upfront. Open Graph tags ensure consistent, professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical channels for reaching business professionals. The copy stays factual, highlights the Claude-powered assistant, and includes the low entry price to reduce friction.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose (AI assistant for trade and business), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with 'no card required' to reduce friction and drive conversions. Copy stays factual and aligns with the professional, confident tone.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited searches, voice chat, and a full workspace built for serious trade and business professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the free-to-paid journey. It reassures visitors they won't be cut off unexpectedly, clearly explains pricing without pressure, and highlights the value they'll gain by converting—reducing hesitation and supporting informed purchase decisions.
